requirement: Section 9/10: deterministic reconciliation of every MATERIAL Pass-A item against the composed IR (REPRESENTED / INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL / UNSUPPORTED / AMBIGUOUS / MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION), MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION as a first-class safety signal that forbids COMPLETE, plus separate quantitative reconciliation proving every material source value is in the final IR or explicitly dispositioned. No model decides the final status.
implementation: lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic-accountability/reconciliation.ts (reconcileInventoryWithComposition) + rollup.ts (rollupAgreementSemanticStatus); wired in compile.ts after normalization + IR validation.
irWalk: Collects (a) LINEAGE entries: every rule/definition/shared-capacity/condition/exception/expression node carrying inventoryItemIds, classified REPRESENTED / UNSUPPORTED (the node is UNSUPPORTED or sits inside an UNSUPPORTED node's attemptedStructure) / UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY (IRRule.unresolvedDependencies); (b) IR VALUES: MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO/NUMBER literals, DATE_LITERAL, and the IR's own structured time/description strings (DURING_PERIOD.periodDescription, EVENT_ACTIVE.activeDuration/eventDescription, AS_OF.asOfDate, SCHEDULE case from/to/description, condition/exception descriptions, shared-capacity description) flagged when they sit inside attemptedStructure; (c) referenced term names (METRIC_REFERENCE/DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE/definition dependsOnTerms) and unresolved dependency target refs.
itemDispositionRules: Lineage present AND any stated value absent from the IR => MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION (a lineage claim without value correspondence never earns credit - audit §33 'composition linking every item without semantic correspondence').
Lineage present on a REPRESENTED node AND every stated value present => REPRESENTED.
Lineage only on UNSUPPORTED structure => UNSUPPORTED; lineage only on an unresolved dependency => AMBIGUOUS.

No lineage, explicit composition disposition INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL/UNSUPPORTED/AMBIGUOUS => that disposition (a self-declared REPRESENTED is ignored - representation is inferred from the IR, never asserted).
No lineage, no disposition, but every stated value present in the IR => REPRESENTED (inferred by value correspondence, disclosed in the reason).

No lineage, DEPENDENCY/REFERENCE item whose referenced term appears as a reference/dependency in the IR => REPRESENTED (inferred by term correspondence); referenced section carried as an unresolved dependency => AMBIGUOUS.
No lineage, values present only inside attemptedStructure => UNSUPPORTED.
quantitativeRules: MONEY -> MONEY literal amount; PERCENT -> PERCENT literal; RATIO/MULTIPLIER -> RATIO or NUMBER literal; DAYS/PERIOD/NUMBER -> NUMBER literal or a structured time/description string containing the raw text or the normalized number; DATE -> DATE_LITERAL isoDate (calendar text normalized to ISO) or a structured string containing it. Numeric equality uses the same 1e-6 relative tolerance as the verifier. A value found only inside attemptedStructure is VALUE_DISPOSITIONED (unsupported), never VALUE_PRESENT_IN_IR.
materialityScope: Counts and gates use CRITICAL + MATERIAL items only; INFORMATIONAL and REVIEW_UNCERTAIN items are still classified and reported but never block or excuse completeness. Deterministic-scanner values no inventory item covers are reported (uninventoriedValues); MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO ones in the OPERATIVE region additionally block semanticallyComplete (materiality undetermined -> review), DATE/DAYS/PERIOD ones do not.
semanticallyComplete: inventoryStatus INVENTORY_OK AND sourceContextState in {COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE, DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE} AND 0 material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION AND 0 material values missing AND 0 uninventoried operative money/percent/ratio values AND 0 dangling lineage references (an IR node or disposition naming an inventoryItemId the frozen inventory never had).
compileEffect: failureReasons SOURCE_CONTEXT_TRUNCATED / SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE / INVENTORY_ITEM_MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION feed the existing determineStatus (=> at least REVIEW_REQUIRED, never COMPLETED); result.accountability carries the full per-item table for audit and for the agreement rollup. INVENTORY_SKIPPED_NO_PROVIDER is disclosed (semanticallyComplete=false) without a failure reason.
agreementRollup: rollup.ts: unit => SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE if compile FAILED, any material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION/missing value, or verification MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY; else REVIEW_REQUIRED if accountability is absent/not complete, compile not COMPLETED, not verified clean, operative state uncertain, or unresolved cross-references remain; else SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE. Agreement => SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE if any unit is, or any material item is MISSING anywhere (hard requirement §26); REVIEW_REQUIRED if any unit requires review; SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE only when every unit is.
verifierIndependence: semantic-verification/* neither imports nor reads result.accountability/frozenInventory/sourceContext (enforced by tests/contract-model/semantic-accountability-independence.test.ts). Reconciliation evidence is available to humans and the rollup, not to the reviewer's judgment.
